item.title: SecLog: log the data handover, not the payment
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: “the user cannot deny receiving the data” needs no trusted API and no data on chain — only a design where the last half of the decryption key can appear through one path, and that path leaves a record. Just over two minutes: how a key becomes a log entry → the two events and what each one proves → the 8,000-gas gap, and why I could not reproduce the absolute number.
